standard: Taxonomy Isolation: Cyberbullying Labels vs Wellbeing Indicators

mappings.original_definition: Tweets targeting religious identity, practices, or communities
mappings.reason: Exact 1-to-1 semantic match with CyberGuard Religion-based cyberbullying class.

mappings.original_definition: Tweets targeting individuals based on age, school harassment, or generational abuse
mappings.reason: Exact 1-to-1 semantic match with CyberGuard Age-based cyberbullying class.

mappings.original_definition: Tweets with sexist insults, misogyny, or gender discrimination
mappings.reason: Exact 1-to-1 semantic match with CyberGuard Gender-based cyberbullying class.

mappings.original_definition: Tweets containing racial slurs, xenophobic attacks, or ethnic vilification
mappings.reason: Exact 1-to-1 semantic match with CyberGuard Ethnicity-based cyberbullying class.

mappings.original_definition: Neutral, benign, or conversational tweets with zero harassment
mappings.reason: Exact 1-to-1 semantic match with CyberGuard Non-cyberbullying baseline class.

mappings.original_definition: Aggressive, defamatory, or hostile harassment not fitting identity tags
mappings.reason: Consists of direct personal harassment, stalkerish commentary, and hostile interpersonal targeting.

mappings.original_definition: Absence of cyberbullying in Hindi, English, and Hinglish tweets
mappings.reason: Binary 0 denotes benign content across multilingual Hindi/English stream.

mappings.original_definition: Cyberbullying observed in Hindi, English, and Hinglish tweets
mappings.reason: Manual lexical inspection verifies >75% of positive class consists of profanities, derogatory epithets, and abusive insults.

mappings.original_definition: Non-abusive conversational Hinglish text
mappings.reason: Direct mapping to non-cyberbullying class for Roman Hindi / Hinglish.

mappings.original_definition: Abusive, vulgar, or defamatory Hinglish comment
mappings.reason: High density of Hindi curse words (gaaliyan), Roman Hindi derogatory slang, and abusive vocabulary.

mappings.original_definition: Threats of physical harm, death, violence, or bodily injury
mappings.reason: Explicit threat definitions align perfectly with CyberGuard Threat/Intimidation.

mappings.original_definition: Insults, name-calling, and disparaging verbal abuse
mappings.reason: Direct alignment with CyberGuard Abusive/Insult category.

mappings.original_definition: Hate speech targeting religion, race, gender, sexual orientation, disability
mappings.reason: Multi-identity attribute; preserved as auxiliary signal without corrupting granular religion/gender splits.

mappings.original_definition: Target CyberGuard classes natively generated in English, Hindi, and Hinglish
mappings.reason: Ground truth baseline training set created precisely for CyberGuard taxonomy.

mappings.original_definition: Severely duplicated 40 template sentences repeated 25,000 times
mappings.reason: 99.84% mechanical duplicate rate creates extreme data leakage and overfit memorization.

mappings.original_definition: Posts sourced from r/SuicideWatch indicating acute suicidal ideation
mappings.reason: Direct triage signal to trigger CyberGuard crisis escalation modal and Tele-MANAS (14416) / Cybercrime (1930) contacts.

mappings.original_definition: Posts sourced from r/depression indicating severe depressive affect without acute crisis
mappings.reason: Signals deep emotional distress requiring empathetic RAG-guided wellbeing responses and consultant escalation.

mappings.original_definition: Posts exhibiting acute Loss of Self cognitive distortion following online abuse
mappings.reason: Cognitive distress signal enabling RAG support agent to identify victim triggers and cognitive reframing.

mappings.original_definition: Posts without Loss of Self distortion
mappings.reason: Baseline emotional affect.

mappings.original_definition: Google Research GoEmotions sentiment labels
mappings.reason: Physical file goemotions_1-selected-columns.csv on disk contains 100% NaN entries.

mappings.original_definition: Calibrated stress levels for CyberGuard support system
mappings.reason: Native baseline for stress level categorization.
